data.narrative:
Basecamp Research is a Series B biotech company founded by Oliver Vince and Glen Gowers that has raised $85M to date. Valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 8 private and 3 public companies in Biotech & Health, including Series B and Series C stage comparables such as Eikon Therapeutics ($539M), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression anchors to the $85M raised as a proxy base and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $162M. The peer-median method uses four same-sector comparable valuations spanning $539M to $10.3B, with a median of $3.5B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of revenue data; the sector median P/S of 8.1x across three public tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) is not actionable without the target's revenue.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $137M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.8B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around stage positioning relative to the peer set. Stage-progression suggests a floor near $162M, while peer-median anchoring suggests significantly higher valuations are defensible for Series B companies in this sector. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to peer cohorts, clinical/technical progress, and whether peer comparables appropriately reflect Basecamp's risk profile versus later-stage funded competitors.
